caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical object placed horizontally against a plain, light background. The main body of the object is a uniform cylinder, cream to light brown in color, with shading indicating a solid, smooth surface. At each end of the cylinder, there is a conical, tapering extension, also rendered in similar cream to brown tones, but with darker shading around the edges to indicate shape and depth. The cylindrical body forms the majority of the object's length, and the tapering extensions at both ends are symmetrical. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing, and the only text visible is "A. HAUGLAND," positioned just to the right of the cylindrical section.
